concept_updates.description: An arrangement that specifies care or guardianship responsibilities for a dependent, such as a minor.
An arrangement that specifies how relevant assets are to be managed.
An evaluation of a person's willingness and suitability for a responsibility.
A legally structured arrangement, such as a trust, used to organize rights or responsibilities.

operator_updates.description: Relates a legal document or legal arrangement to the legal decision that it formally records.

notes: The documents relation is treated as specific because both observed uses record a legal decision in a will or trust.
